citations.quote: The ambient Jacobian problem, however, is over an arbitrary characteristic-zero field K (and in particular over C)

A KILL says that the indicated residue obligation cannot occur over the splitting field of the fixed quartic q ... its splitting field has the unique quadratic subfield Q(sqrt(17)). It contains neither sqrt(105) nor sqrt(170). Thus C08 and C20 have no torus point over the splitting field. ... So the obstruction is arithmetic, not a sign/no-real-point obstruction.
No multi-term shape is sign-killed over the reals. C08 and C20 have real points but no points over Q or over the q-splitting field

the residues (D,X,S,E) and every jet ... are free rational Taylor coefficients of the unknown polynomials d2,d1,sigma,e about y=-1 ... They are *not* confined to the q-splitting field - that confinement is the q-place phenomenon behind the only two kills C08/C20.
Arithmetic (square-class) obstructions live only at the q-place, where residues are confined to the q-splitting field Q(sqrt(17)).

a8_sign_split_audit.reasoning: The C08/C20 kills are justified by confinement of q-PLACE residues to the q-splitting field, and even there the obstruction is arithmetic (square classes 105/170 missing from the unique quadratic subfield Q(sqrt(17))), explicitly NOT a realness/sign obstruction. The a8 residual's symbols are GLOBAL leading y-coefficients of d1, sigma, e over the ground field K, which FIELD_SPLIT_AUDIT.md fixes as an arbitrary characteristic-zero field; they are exactly the kind of free coefficients RESIDUE_LEMMAS_DEPTH.md says are NOT confined. No repo statement embeds them in an ordered/real field, so a gamma>0 vs gamma<0 positivity split is not available unconditionally.
